To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the sorghum germ plasm from Eastern Highlands of Ethiopia is highly diverse for most of the traits studied.
the phenotypic diversity index (H′) was relatively higher in Hadiya (H′ = 0.75), followed by Arssi (H′ =0.73), and the lowest in Gurage (H′ =.66) and Alemaya (H′ =.66).
the sorghum germoplasm studied showed wide morpho-agroonomic diversity and the between localities variation is relatively smaller than the within locality component.

the evaluation of sorghum germ plasm from Eastern Ethiopia for morpho-agronomic traits and the determination of the genetic diversity of the sorghums in the region.
the evaluation of sorghum germ plasm from the eastern highlands of Ethiopia for morphological diversity.
the characterization and evaluation of sorghum germ plasm in Eastern highlands of Ethiopia.

there is a considerable diversity in the sorghum germ plasm studied.

there is a great variation in qualitative characters among the sorghum germ-plasm from the Eastern Highlands of the Ethiopia.
